args.title: Retail Returns Logistics – Saltmarsh Summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, which puts heavy pressure on returns logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days kept most of the margin (companion piece).

Sources: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns ; https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion
